fields.summary_ko.0: Berkshire Hathaway (BRKA -0.78%, BRKB -0.76%) shares have risen approximately 9% this year following Greg Abel's assumption of CEO role, though management succession concerns persist.
fields.summary_ko.1: Following Buffett's step-down from chairman, operational leadership has fully transitioned to Abel. Portfolio concentration in technology stocks like Alphabet and Bending Spoon has increased risk.
fields.summary_ko.2: Given Abel's limited portfolio management experience and the trend toward increased technology weighting, a cautious monitoring approach is recommended at present.
